                        &mut self.workspace_replace_value
                    } else {
                        &mut self.workspace_search_query
                    };
                    if let Some((start, _)) = value.grapheme_indices(true).next_back() {
                        value.truncate(start);
                    }
                    if !self.workspace_replace_mode {
                        self.start_workspace_search();
                    }
                }
                KeyCode::Char(character)
                    if key.modifiers.is_empty() || key.modifiers == KeyModifiers::SHIFT =>
                {
                    if self.workspace_replace_mode {
                        self.workspace_replace_value.push(character);
                    } else {
                        self.workspace_search_query.push(character);
                        self.start_workspace_search();
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if self.command_palette {
            return self.handle_command_palette(key);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('p')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.open_command_palette();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('p') && key.modifiers == KeyModifiers::CONTROL {
            self.open_file_finder();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('f')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.open_workspace_search();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if self.searching {
            if key.code == KeyCode::Char('f')
                && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
                && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
            {
                self.search_regex = !self.search_regex;
                self.refresh_search();
                return Ok(false);
            }
            if key.code == KeyCode::Char('r')
                && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
                && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
            {
                self.replace_all_matches()?;
                return Ok(false);
            }
            if key.code == KeyCode::Char('r')
                && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
                && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
            {
                self.replace_current_match()?;
                return Ok(false);
            }
            match key.code {
                KeyCode::Esc => {
                    self.searching = false;
                    self.search_query.clear();
                    self.search_matches.clear();
                }
                KeyCode::Backspace => {
                    if let Some((start, _)) = self.search_query.grapheme_indices(true).next_back() {
                        self.search_query.truncate(start);
                    }
                    self.refresh_search();
                }
                KeyCode::Enter => self.jump_to_next_match(),
                KeyCode::Char(ch) if !key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                    self.search_query.push(ch);
                    self.refresh_search();
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Tab && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
            self.switch_tab(if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) {
                -1
            } else {
                1
            });
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::PageDown && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
            self.switch_tab(1);
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.modifiers.is_empty() && matches!(key.code, KeyCode::PageUp | KeyCode::PageDown) {
            let delta = if key.code == KeyCode::PageUp { -10 } else { 10 };
            self.scroll_editor(delta);
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::PageUp && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
            self.switch_tab(-1);
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('w')
            && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
            && !key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            self.close_tab(key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT));
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('p')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.pin_current_tab();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char(' ') && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
            self.request_completion();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('i') && key.modifiers == KeyModifiers::CONTROL {
            self.request_hover();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::F(9) {
            if key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
            {
                self.cancel_task()?;
                return Ok(false);
            }
            self.start_task(key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL))?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('t')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.start_test_task()?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::F(4) {
            self.jump_to_first_problem()?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('d')
            && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
            && !key
                .modifiers
                .intersects(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SUPER)
        {
            self.add_cursor_below();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('d') && key.modifiers == KeyModifiers::CONTROL {
            self.add_next_search_cursor();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
            && matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Up | KeyCode::Down)
        {
            if !self.readonly {
                let line = self.current_line();
                let column = self.current_column();
                let delta = if key.code == KeyCode::Up { -1 } else { 1 };
                self.document.move_line(line, delta)?;
                let target_line = if delta < 0 {
                    line.saturating_sub(1)
                } else {
                    line.saturating_add(1)
                };
                self.cursor = self
                    .document
                    .line_column_to_byte(target_line, column)
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| self.document.line_to_byte(target_line).unwrap_or(0));
                self.selection = None;
                self.extra_cursors.clear();
            }
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('t')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            self.send_selection_to_terminal(key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT))?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('`') && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) {
            if self.terminal_panel.is_fullscreen() {
                self.terminal_panel.toggle_fullscreen();
                self.terminal_panel.set_focus(false);
                self.notification = Some("editor focused".into());
            } else {
                self.toggle_terminal()?;
            }
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('t')
            && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
            && !key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
        {
            if self.terminal_panel.sessions.is_empty() {
                self.toggle_terminal()?;
            }
            self.terminal_panel.toggle_fullscreen();
            self.terminal_panel.set_focus(true);
            self.notification = Some(if self.terminal_panel.is_fullscreen() {
                "terminal fullscreen".into()
            } else {
                "editor focused".into()
            });
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('w')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.save_workspace_file()?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('z')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            self.zen_mode = !self.zen_mode;
            self.terminal_panel.set_focus(false);
            self.notification = Some(if self.zen_mode {
                "zen mode enabled".into()
            } else {
                "zen mode disabled".into()
            });
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('y')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            self.sticky_context = !self.sticky_context;
            self.notification = Some(
                if self.sticky_context {
                    "sticky context enabled"
                } else {
                    "sticky context disabled"
                }
                .into(),
            );
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('d')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.toggle_editor_diff_mode();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('s')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            self.stage_editor_current_hunk()?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('r')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            self.rollback_editor_current_hunk()?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('\\')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.editor_split = true;
            self.editor_split_horizontal = !self.editor_split_horizontal;
            self.notification = Some(
                if self.editor_split_horizontal {
                    "horizontal editor split enabled"
                } else {
                    "vertical editor split enabled"
                }
                .into(),
            );
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('\\')
            && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
            && !key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            self.editor_split = !self.editor_split;
            self.notification = Some(
                if self.editor_split {
                    "editor split enabled"
                } else {
                    "editor split disabled"
                }
                .into(),
            );
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key.code == KeyCode::Char('l')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.jump_to_terminal_link()?;
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if self.terminal_panel.is_focused()
            && key.code == KeyCode::Char('c')
            && key
                .modifiers
                .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT)
        {
            self.copy_terminal_selection();
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if self.route_terminal_key(key)? {
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key
            .modifiers
            .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT)
            && key.code == KeyCode::Char('o')
        {
            self.open_workspace_root_input(key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT));
            return Ok(false);
        }
        if key
            .modifiers
            .contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) {
                let choice = match key.code {
                    KeyCode::Char('1') => Some(ConflictChoice::Ours),
                    KeyCode::Char('2') => Some(ConflictChoice::Theirs),
                    KeyCode::Char('3') => Some(ConflictChoice::Both),
                    KeyCode::Char('0') => Some(ConflictChoice::Neither),
                    _ => None,
                };
                if let Some(choice) = choice {
                    self.resolve_all_conflicts(choice)?;
                    return Ok(false);
                }
            }
            let choice = match key.code {
                KeyCode::Char('1') => Some(ConflictChoice::Ours),
                KeyCode::Char('2') => Some(ConflictChoice::Theirs),
                KeyCode::Char('3') => Some(ConflictChoice::Both),
                KeyCode::Char('0') => Some(ConflictChoice::Neither),
                _ => None,
            };
            if let Some(choice) = choice {
                self.resolve_conflict_at_cursor(choice)?;
                return Ok(false);
            }
        }
        if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
            && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
        {
            match key.code {
                KeyCode::Right => {
                    self.expand_selection();
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                KeyCode::Left => {
                    self.shrink_selection();
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        if key
            .modifiers
            .intersects(KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SUPER)
        {
            if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {
                if key.code == KeyCode::Char('(') {
                    self.surround_current_selection('(', ')')?;
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                if key.code == KeyCode::Char('"') {
                    self.surround_current_selection('"', '"')?;
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                if key.code == KeyCode::Backspace {
                    self.remove_surrounding_pair()?;
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                let style = match key.code {
                    KeyCode::Char('u') => Some(NamingStyle::Upper),
                    KeyCode::Char('l') => Some(NamingStyle::Lower),
                    KeyCode::Char('c') => Some(NamingStyle::Camel),
                    KeyCode::Char('p') => Some(NamingStyle::Pascal),
                    KeyCode::Char('s') => Some(NamingStyle::Snake),
                    KeyCode::Char('k') => Some(NamingStyle::Kebab),
                    _ => None,
                };
                if let Some(style) = style {
                    self.convert_current_identifier(style)?;
                    return Ok(false);
                }
            }
            if self.external_change {
                match (key.code, key.modifiers) {
                    (KeyCode::Char('r'), modifiers)
                        if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) =>
                    {
                        self.reload_external()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    (KeyCode::Char('s'), modifiers)
                        if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
                            && modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) =>
                    {
                        self.overwrite_external()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    (KeyCode::Char('d'), modifiers)
                        if modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL)
                            && modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) =>
                    {
                        self.compare_external()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) {
                match key.code {
                    KeyCode::Char('k') => {
                        self.delete_current_line()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    KeyCode::Char('d') => {
                        self.duplicate_current_line()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    KeyCode::Char('c') => {
                        self.copy_selection();
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    KeyCode::Char('x') => {
                        self.cut_selection()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    KeyCode::Char('v') => {
                        self.paste_clipboard()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    KeyCode::Char('r') => {
                        self.replace_current_match()?;
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
            if key.code == KeyCode::Char('w') && key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {
                self.word_wrap = !self.word_wrap;
                self.horizontal_scroll = 0;
                self.notification = Some(if self.word_wrap {
                    "soft wrap enabled".into()
                } else {
                    "horizontal scrolling enabled".into()
                });
                return Ok(false);
            }
            if matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Left | KeyCode::Right) {
                self.move_by_word(key.code == KeyCode::Right);
                return Ok(false);
            }
            if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT)
                && matches!(key.code, KeyCode::Char('[') | KeyCode::Char(']'))
            {
                if key.code == KeyCode::Char('[') {
                    self.set_all_folds(true);
                } else {
                    self.set_all_folds(false);
                }
                return Ok(false);
            }
            match key.code {
                KeyCode::Char('/') => {
                    self.toggle_comment_current_line()?;
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                KeyCode::Char('q') | KeyCode::Char('c') => return Ok(true),
                KeyCode::Char('s') => {
                    if let Err(error) = self.save() {
                        if matches!(error, AppError::ExternalChange(_)) {
                            self.external_change = true;
                            self.notification =
                                Some("save blocked: reload/compare/overwrite".into());
                        } else {
                            return Err(error);
                        }
                    }
                }
                KeyCode::Char('f') => {
                    self.searching = true;
                    self.search_query.clear();
                    self.search_matches.clear();
                }
                KeyCode::Char('g') => self.jump_to_next_symbol(),
                KeyCode::Char('[') if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT) => {
                    self.toggle_fold_at_cursor();
                }
                KeyCode::Char('z') => {
                    let _ = self.document.undo();
                    self.cursor = self.cursor.min(self.document.text().len());
                }
                KeyCode::Char('y') => {
                    let _ = self.document.redo();
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            return Ok(false);
        }
        match key.code {
            KeyCode::Esc => Ok(true),
            KeyCode::Left if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                self.move_by_word(false);
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Left => {
                if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {
                    self.navigate_back();
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                let next = self.prev_boundary();
                self.update_selection(next, key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT));
                self.desired_column = self.current_column();
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Right if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                self.move_by_word(true);
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Right => {
                if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::ALT) {
                    self.navigate_forward();
                    return Ok(false);
                }
                let next = self.next_boundary();
                self.update_selection(next, key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT));
                self.desired_column = self.current_column();
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Up if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                self.move_by_paragraph(-1);
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Up => {
                self.move_vertical(-1);
                self.selection = None;
                self.extra_cursors.clear();
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Down if key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::CONTROL) => {
                self.move_by_paragraph(1);
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Down => {
                self.move_vertical(1);
                self.selection = None;
                self.extra_cursors.clear();
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Home => {
                let line = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0);
                let start = self.document.line_to_byte(line).unwrap_or(0);
                let text = self.document.text();
                let end = self.document.line_to_byte(line + 1).unwrap_or(text.len());
                let line_text = &text[start..end];
                let first_non_space = line_text
                    .find(|character: char| !character.is_whitespace())
                    .unwrap_or(0);
                let target = if self.cursor == start + first_non_space {
                    start
                } else {
                    start + first_non_space
                };
                self.update_selection(target, key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT));
                self.desired_column = self.current_column();
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::End => {
                let line = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0);
                let start = self.document.line_to_byte(line).unwrap_or(0);
                let end = self
                    .document
                    .line_to_byte(line + 1)
                    .unwrap_or_else(|| self.document.text().len());
                let text = self.document.text();
                let target = end.saturating_sub(usize::from(
                    text.as_bytes().get(end.saturating_sub(1)) == Some(&b'\n'),
                ));
                let target = target.max(start);
                self.update_selection(target, key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT));
                self.desired_column = self.current_column();
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Backspace => {
                if !self.readonly && (self.selection.is_some() || self.cursor > 0) {
                    if let Some(selection) = self.selection.take() {
                        let range = selection.range();
                        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
                            range: range.clone(),
                            insert: String::new(),
                        }])?;
                        self.cursor = range.start;
                    } else {
                        let start = self.prev_boundary();
                        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
                            range: start..self.cursor,
                            insert: String::new(),
                        }])?;
                        self.cursor = start;
                    }
                }
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Enter => {
                if !self.readonly {
                    let text = self.document.text();
                    let line = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0);
                    let start = self.document.line_to_byte(line).unwrap_or(0);
                    let prefix = text[start..self.cursor]
                        .chars()
                        .take_while(|ch| ch.is_whitespace() && *ch != '\n')
                        .collect::<String>();
                    let extra = text[..self.cursor].ends_with('{');
                    let unit = if self.insert_spaces {
                        " ".repeat(self.tab_width as usize)
                    } else {
                        "\t".into()
                    };
                    let mut insertion = format!("\n{prefix}");
                    if extra {
                        insertion.push_str(&unit);
                    }
                    self.insert(&insertion)?;
                }
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Tab => {
                if !self.readonly {
                    if self.advance_snippet(key.modifiers.contains(KeyModifiers::SHIFT)) {
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    if self.expand_current_snippet()? {
                        return Ok(false);
                    }
                    let indentation = if self.insert_spaces {
                        " ".repeat(self.tab_width as usize)
                    } else {
                        "\t".to_owned()
                    };
                    self.insert(&indentation)?;
                }
                Ok(false)
            }
            KeyCode::Char(ch) => {
                if !self.readonly {
                    let closing = matches!(ch, ')' | ']' | '}');
                    let pair = match ch {
                        '(' => Some(')'),
                        '[' => Some(']'),
                        '{' => Some('}'),
                        '"' => Some('"'),
                        '\'' => Some('\''),
                        _ => None,
                    };
                    let text = self.document.text();
                    if closing && text[self.cursor..].starts_with(ch) {
                        self.cursor += ch.len_utf8();
                    } else if let Some(close) = pair {
                        self.insert(&format!("{ch}{close}"))?;
                        self.cursor = self.cursor.saturating_sub(close.len_utf8());
                    } else {
                        self.insert(&ch.to_string())?;
                    }
                }
                Ok(false)
            }
            _ => Ok(false),
        }
    }

    fn advance_snippet(&mut self, backward: bool) -> bool {
        if self.snippet_stops.is_empty() {
            return false;
        }
        if backward {
            self.snippet_index = self.snippet_index.saturating_sub(1);
        } else if self.snippet_index + 1 < self.snippet_stops.len() {
            self.snippet_index += 1;
        } else {
            self.snippet_stops.clear();
            self.snippet_index = 0;
            return true;
        }
        let (start, end) = self.snippet_stops[self.snippet_index];
        self.cursor = end;
        self.selection = (start != end).then(|| Selection::new(start, end));
        true
    }

    fn convert_current_identifier(&mut self, style: NamingStyle) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let text = self.document.text();
        let range = self.selection.map(Selection::range).unwrap_or_else(|| {
            let start = text[..self.cursor]
                .char_indices()
                .rev()
                .take_while(|(_, character)| character.is_alphanumeric() || *character == '_')
                .last()
                .map(|(offset, _)| offset)
                .unwrap_or(self.cursor);
            let end = text[self.cursor..]
                .char_indices()
                .take_while(|(_, character)| character.is_alphanumeric() || *character == '_')
                .last()
                .map(|(offset, character)| self.cursor + offset + character.len_utf8())
                .unwrap_or(self.cursor);
            start..end
        });
        if range.start == range.end {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let replacement = convert_identifier(&text[range.clone()], style);
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: range.clone(),
            insert: replacement.clone(),
        }])?;
        self.cursor = range.start + replacement.len();
        self.selection = None;
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn selected_or_current_line(&self) -> Range<usize> {
        if let Some(selection) = self.selection {
            return selection.range();
        }
        let line = self.current_line();
        let start = self.document.line_to_byte(line).unwrap_or(0);
        let text = self.document.text();
        let end = self
            .document
            .line_to_byte(line + 1)
            .unwrap_or(text.len())
            .min(text.len());
        start
            ..end.saturating_sub(usize::from(
                text.as_bytes().get(end.saturating_sub(1)) == Some(&b'\n'),
            ))
    }

    fn smart_selection_range(&self) -> Range<usize> {
        let text = self.document.text();
        if let Some(selection) = self.selection {
            return selection.range();
        }
        let cursor = self.cursor.min(text.len());
        let mut start = cursor;
        let mut end = cursor;
        for (offset, character) in text[..cursor].char_indices().rev() {
            if character.is_alphanumeric() || character == '_' {
                start = offset;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        for (offset, character) in text[cursor..].char_indices() {
            if character.is_alphanumeric() || character == '_' {
                end = cursor + offset + character.len_utf8();
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        if start != end {
            return start..end;
        }
        self.selected_or_current_line()
    }

    fn expand_selection(&mut self) {
        let had_selection = self.selection.is_some();
        let current = self.smart_selection_range();
        let text = self.document.text();
        if !had_selection {
            self.selection_history.push(None);
            self.selection = Some(Selection::new(current.start, current.end));
            self.cursor = current.end;
            return;
        }
        let mut next = current.clone();
        let pairs = [('(', ')'), ('[', ']'), ('{', '}')];
        if let (Some(left), Some(right)) = (
            text[..current.start].chars().next_back(),
            text[current.end..].chars().next(),
        ) {
            if pairs
                .iter()
                .any(|(open, close)| left == *open && right == *close)
            {
                next = current.start.saturating_sub(left.len_utf8())
                    ..(current.end + right.len_utf8()).min(text.len());
            }
        }
        if next == current {
            let line = self.document.byte_to_line(current.start).unwrap_or(0);
            let line_start = self.document.line_to_byte(line).unwrap_or(0);
            let line_end = self
                .document
                .line_to_byte(line + 1)
                .unwrap_or(text.len())
                .min(text.len());
            let trimmed_end = line_end.saturating_sub(usize::from(
                text.as_bytes().get(line_end.saturating_sub(1)) == Some(&b'\n'),
            ));
            if current.start > line_start || current.end < trimmed_end {
                next = line_start..trimmed_end;
            } else {
                next = 0..text.len();
            }
        }
        if next.start == current.start && next.end == current.end {
            return;
        }
        self.selection_history.push(self.selection);
        self.selection = Some(Selection::new(next.start, next.end));
        self.cursor = next.end;
    }

    fn shrink_selection(&mut self) {
        let Some(previous) = self.selection_history.pop() else {
            return;
        };
        let current = self.selection.map(Selection::range);
        self.selection = previous;
        self.cursor = self
            .selection
            .map(|selection| selection.active)
            .or_else(|| current.map(|range| range.start))
            .unwrap_or(self.cursor);
    }

    fn surround_current_selection(&mut self, open: char, close: char) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let range = self.selected_or_current_line();
        let selected = self.document.text()[range.clone()].to_owned();
        let replacement = format!("{open}{selected}{close}");
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: range.clone(),
            insert: replacement,
        }])?;
        self.cursor = range.start + 1 + selected.len();
        self.selection = None;
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn remove_surrounding_pair(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let text = self.document.text();
        let cursor = self.cursor.min(text.len());
        let pairs = [('(', ')'), ('[', ']'), ('{', '}'), ('"', '"'), ('\'', '\'')];
        let Some((open, close)) = pairs.into_iter().find(|(open, close)| {
            cursor > 0 && text[..cursor].ends_with(*open) && text[cursor..].starts_with(*close)
        }) else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let start = text[..cursor].rfind(open).unwrap_or(cursor);
        let end = cursor + close.len_utf8();
        if start >= cursor {
            return Ok(());
        }
        self.document.apply(&[
            Edit {
                range: start..start + open.len_utf8(),
                insert: String::new(),
            },
            Edit {
                range: end..end + close.len_utf8(),
                insert: String::new(),
            },
        ])?;
        self.cursor = cursor.saturating_sub(open.len_utf8());
        Ok(())
    }

    fn expand_current_snippet(&mut self) -> Result<bool, AppError> {
        let text = self.document.text();
        let start = text[..self.cursor]
            .char_indices()
            .rev()
            .take_while(|(_, character)| character.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || *character == '_')
            .last()
            .map(|(offset, _)| offset)
            .unwrap_or(self.cursor);
        let trigger = &text[start..self.cursor];
        let body = match trigger {
            "for" => "for ${1:item} in ${2:items} {\n    $0\n}",
            "fn" => "fn ${1:name}(${2:args}) {\n    $0\n}",
            _ => return Ok(false),
        };
        let filename = self
            .path
            .as_deref()
            .and_then(Path::file_name)
            .and_then(|name| name.to_str());
        let expansion = expand_snippet(body, filename);
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: start..self.cursor,
            insert: expansion.text,
        }])?;
        self.snippet_stops = expansion
            .tabstops
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(begin, end)| (start + begin, start + end))
            .collect();
        self.snippet_index = 0;
        if let Some((begin, end)) = self.snippet_stops.first().copied() {
            self.cursor = end;
            self.selection = (begin != end).then(|| Selection::new(begin, end));
        } else {
            self.cursor = start + body.len();
        }
        Ok(true)
    }

    fn insert(&mut self, text: &str) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if !self.extra_cursors.is_empty() && self.selection.is_none() {
            let mut positions = self.extra_cursors.clone();
            positions.push(self.cursor);
            positions.sort_unstable();
            positions.dedup();
            let primary = positions
                .iter()
                .position(|position| *position == self.cursor)
                .unwrap_or(0);
            self.document.insert_at_cursors(&positions, text)?;
            let new_positions = positions
                .iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(index, position)| position + index * text.len())
                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            self.cursor = new_positions[primary];
            self.extra_cursors = new_positions
                .into_iter()
                .enumerate()
                .filter_map(|(index, position)| (index != primary).then_some(position))
                .collect();
            self.desired_column = self.current_column();
            return Ok(());
        }
        let range = self
            .selection
            .take()
            .map(Selection::range)
            .unwrap_or(self.cursor..self.cursor);
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: range.clone(),
            insert: text.into(),
        }])?;
        self.cursor = range.start + text.len();
        self.desired_column = self.current_column();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn copy_selection(&mut self) {
        let text = self
            .selection
            .and_then(|selection| self.document.selected_text(selection).ok())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        if text.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        self.clipboard = text.clone();
        self.clipboard_history.push(text);
    }

    fn cut_selection(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        let Some(selection) = self.selection else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.clipboard = self.document.selected_text(selection)?;
        self.clipboard_history.push(self.clipboard.clone());
        let range = selection.range();
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: range.clone(),
            insert: String::new(),
        }])?;
        self.cursor = range.start;
        self.selection = None;
        Ok(())
    }

    fn paste_clipboard(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if !self.clipboard.is_empty() && !self.readonly {
            let clipboard = self.clipboard.clone();
            self.insert(&clipboard)?;
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn replace_current_match(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.search_matches.is_empty() || self.clipboard.is_empty() || self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let Some(range) = self
            .search_matches
            .iter()
            .find(|range| range.start >= self.cursor)
            .cloned()
            .or_else(|| self.search_matches.first().cloned())
        else {
            return Ok(());
        };
        let replacement_len = self.clipboard.len();
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: range.clone(),
            insert: self.clipboard.clone(),
        }])?;
        self.cursor = range.start + replacement_len;
        self.refresh_search();
        self.notification = Some("replaced current match".into());
        Ok(())
    }

    fn replace_all_matches(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.search_query.is_empty() || self.clipboard.is_empty() || self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let count = if self.search_regex {
            self.document
                .replace_all_regex(&self.search_query, &self.clipboard)?
        } else {
            self.document
                .replace_all_literal(&self.search_query, &self.clipboard)?
        };
        self.refresh_search();
        self.notification = Some(format!("replaced {count} matches"));
        Ok(())
    }

    fn current_line(&self) -> usize {
        self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0)
    }

    fn resolve_conflict_at_cursor(&mut self, choice: ConflictChoice) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            self.notification = Some("cannot resolve conflict in read-only file".into());
            return Ok(());
        }
        let text = self.document.text();
        let Some(block) = find_conflict_blocks(&text)
            .into_iter()
            .find(|block| self.cursor >= block.range.start && self.cursor <= block.range.end)
        else {
            self.notification = Some("no conflict block at cursor".into());
            return Ok(());
        };
        let replacement = match choice {
            ConflictChoice::Ours => block.ours,
            ConflictChoice::Theirs => block.theirs,
            ConflictChoice::Both => format!("{}{}", block.ours, block.theirs),
            ConflictChoice::Neither => String::new(),
        };
        let block_start = block.range.start;
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: block.range,
            insert: replacement,
        }])?;
        self.cursor = block_start.min(self.document.text().len());
        self.selection = None;
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        self.notification = Some(
            match choice {
                ConflictChoice::Ours => "conflict resolved: ours",
                ConflictChoice::Theirs => "conflict resolved: theirs",
                ConflictChoice::Both => "conflict resolved: both",
                ConflictChoice::Neither => "conflict block removed",
            }
            .into(),
        );
        Ok(())
    }

    fn resolve_all_conflicts(&mut self, choice: ConflictChoice) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            self.notification = Some("cannot resolve conflict in read-only file".into());
            return Ok(());
        }
        let blocks = find_conflict_blocks(&self.document.text());
        if blocks.is_empty() {
            self.notification = Some("no conflict blocks found".into());
            return Ok(());
        }
        let edits = blocks
            .iter()
            .map(|block| Edit {
                range: block.range.clone(),
                insert: match choice {
                    ConflictChoice::Ours => block.ours.clone(),
                    ConflictChoice::Theirs => block.theirs.clone(),
                    ConflictChoice::Both => format!("{}{}", block.ours, block.theirs),
                    ConflictChoice::Neither => String::new(),
                },
            })
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        let cursor = blocks[0].range.start;
        self.document.apply(&edits)?;
        self.cursor = cursor.min(self.document.text().len());
        self.selection = None;
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        self.notification = Some(format!(
            "resolved {} conflict block{}",
            blocks.len(),
            if blocks.len() == 1 { "" } else { "s" }
        ));
        Ok(())
    }

    fn restore_conflict_state(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        let Some(path) = self.path.clone() else {
            self.notification = Some("no conflict file is active".into());
            return Ok(());
        };
        let Some(snapshot) = self.conflict_snapshots.get(&path).cloned() else {
            self.notification = Some("no saved conflict state for this file".into());
            return Ok(());
        };
        let length = self.document.text().len();
        self.document.apply(&[Edit {
            range: 0..length,
            insert: snapshot.clone(),
        }])?;
        self.cursor = self.cursor.min(snapshot.len());
        self.notification = Some("conflict state restored; save to keep markers".into());
        Ok(())
    }

    fn delete_current_line(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let line = self.current_line();
        self.document.delete_line(line)?;
        self.cursor = self
            .document
            .line_to_byte(line.min(self.document.line_count().saturating_sub(1)))
            .unwrap_or(0);
        self.selection = None;
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn duplicate_current_line(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let line = self.current_line();
        self.document.duplicate_line(line)?;
        self.selection = None;
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn toggle_comment_current_line(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        if self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let text = self.document.text();
        let language = self
            .path
            .as_deref()
            .map(|path| mtide_syntax::detect_with_text(path, &text))
            .unwrap_or(mtide_syntax::Language::Rust);
        let marker = if matches!(language, mtide_syntax::Language::Python) {
            "#"
        } else {
            "//"
        };
        self.document
            .toggle_line_comment(self.current_line(), marker)?;
        self.selection = None;
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        Ok(())
    }

    fn add_cursor_below(&mut self) {
        let line = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0);
        let Some(position) = self
            .document
            .line_column_to_byte(line + 1, self.current_column())
        else {
            return;
        };
        if position != self.cursor && !self.extra_cursors.contains(&position) {
            self.extra_cursors.push(position);
            self.extra_cursors.sort_unstable();
            if self.extra_cursors.len() > MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS {
                self.extra_cursors.truncate(MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS);
                self.notification = Some(format!(
                    "multi-cursor limit reached ({MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS}); extra cursors ignored"
                ));
            }
        }
    }

    fn add_next_search_cursor(&mut self) {
        let Some(range) = self
            .search_matches
            .iter()
            .find(|range| range.start > self.cursor)
            .cloned()
            .or_else(|| self.search_matches.first().cloned())
        else {
            self.notification = Some("no search matches for multi-cursor".into());
            return;
        };
        if range.start == self.cursor || self.extra_cursors.contains(&range.start) {
            self.notification = Some("all search matches already selected".into());
            return;
        }
        if self.extra_cursors.len() >= MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS {
            self.notification = Some(format!(
                "multi-cursor limit reached ({MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS}); extra cursors ignored"
            ));
            return;
        }
        self.extra_cursors.push(range.start);
        self.extra_cursors.sort_unstable();
        self.notification = Some(format!(
            "multi-cursor: {} active",
            self.extra_cursors.len() + 1
        ));
    }

    fn add_cursors_for_search_matches(&mut self) {
        if self.search_matches.is_empty() {
            self.notification = Some("no search matches for multi-cursor".into());
            return;
        }
        let mut positions = self
            .search_matches
            .iter()
            .map(|range| range.start)
            .filter(|position| *position != self.cursor)
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        positions.sort_unstable();
        positions.dedup();
        let total = positions.len() + 1;
        let truncated = total > MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS + 1;
        positions.truncate(MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS);
        self.extra_cursors = positions;
        self.selection = None;
        self.notification = Some(if truncated {
            format!(
                "selected first {} of {} search matches (multi-cursor limit {})",
                self.extra_cursors.len() + 1,
                total,
                MAX_EXTRA_CURSORS + 1
            )
        } else {
            format!("selected {} search matches", self.extra_cursors.len() + 1)
        });
    }

    fn update_selection(&mut self, cursor: usize, extend: bool) {
        self.extra_cursors.clear();
        if extend {
            let anchor = self
                .selection
                .map(|selection| selection.anchor)
                .unwrap_or(self.cursor);
            self.selection = Some(Selection::new(anchor, cursor));
        } else {
            self.selection = None;
        }
        self.cursor = cursor;
    }

    fn move_by_word(&mut self, forward: bool) {
        let text = self.document.text();
        let target = if forward {
            let suffix = &text[self.cursor.min(text.len())..];
            let mut index = 0;
            let mut saw_word = false;
            for (offset, character) in suffix.char_indices() {
                if character.is_whitespace() {
                    if saw_word {
                        index = offset;
                        break;
                    }
                } else {
                    saw_word = true;
                    index = offset + character.len_utf8();
                }
            }
            self.cursor + index
        } else {
            let prefix = &text[..self.cursor.min(text.len())];
            let mut index = prefix.len();
            let mut saw_word = false;
            for (offset, character) in prefix.char_indices().rev() {
                if character.is_whitespace() {
                    if saw_word {
                        index = offset + character.len_utf8();
                        break;
                    }
                } else {
                    saw_word = true;
                    index = offset;
                }
            }
            index
        };
        self.update_selection(target.min(text.len()), false);
        self.desired_column = self.current_column();
    }

    fn move_by_paragraph(&mut self, direction: isize) {
        let text = self.document.text();
        let lines = text.split('\n').collect::<Vec<_>>();
        if lines.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let current = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0);
        let mut target = current;
        if direction < 0 {
            while target > 0 && !lines[target - 1].trim().is_empty() {
                target -= 1;
            }
            if target == current {
                while target > 0 && lines[target - 1].trim().is_empty() {
                    target -= 1;
                }
                while target > 0 && !lines[target - 1].trim().is_empty() {
                    target -= 1;
                }
            }
        } else {
            while target + 1 < lines.len() && !lines[target + 1].trim().is_empty() {
                target += 1;
            }
            while target + 1 < lines.len() && lines[target + 1].trim().is_empty() {
                target += 1;
            }
            if target + 1 < lines.len() {
                target += 1;
            }
        }
        let target_column = self
            .desired_column
            .min(lines[target].graphemes(true).count());
        if let Some(position) = self.document.line_column_to_byte(target, target_column) {
            self.cursor = position;
            self.selection = None;
        }
    }
    fn prev_boundary(&self) -> usize {
        let text = self.document.text();
        text[..self.cursor]
            .grapheme_indices(true)
            .next_back()
            .map(|(index, _)| index)
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }
    fn next_boundary(&self) -> usize {
        let text = self.document.text();
        self.cursor
            + text[self.cursor..]
                .graphemes(true)
                .next()
                .map(str::len)
                .unwrap_or(0)
    }
    fn move_vertical(&mut self, delta: isize) {
        if self.word_wrap && self.wrap_width > 0 && self.move_visual_vertical(delta) {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(line) = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor) {
            let target = line as isize + delta;
            if target >= 0 {
                if let Some(position) = self
                    .document
                    .line_column_to_byte(target as usize, self.desired_column)
                {
                    self.cursor = position.min(self.document.text().len());
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fn move_visual_vertical(&mut self, delta: isize) -> bool {
        let text = self.document.text();
        let current_line = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0);
        let line_start = self.document.line_to_byte(current_line).unwrap_or(0);
        let column =
            UnicodeSegmentation::graphemes(&text[line_start..self.cursor.min(text.len())], true)
                .count();
        let current_segment = column / self.wrap_width;
        let current_visual = text
            .split('\n')
            .take(current_line)
            .map(|line| {
                line.graphemes(true)
                    .count()
                    .div_ceil(self.wrap_width)
                    .max(1)
            })
            .sum::<usize>()
            + current_segment;
        let target_visual = current_visual as isize + delta;
        if target_visual < 0 {
            return false;
        }
        let mut visual = 0usize;
        for (line, contents) in text.split('\n').enumerate() {
            let count = contents.graphemes(true).count();
            let segments = count.div_ceil(self.wrap_width).max(1);
            if (visual..visual + segments).contains(&(target_visual as usize)) {
                let segment = target_visual as usize - visual;
                let target_column =
                    (segment * self.wrap_width + column % self.wrap_width).min(count);
                if let Some(position) = self.document.line_column_to_byte(line, target_column) {
                    self.cursor = position;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            visual += segments;
        }
        false
    }

    fn current_column(&self) -> usize {
        let text = self.document.text();
        let line = self.document.byte_to_line(self.cursor).unwrap_or(0);
        let start = self.document.line_to_byte(line).unwrap_or(0);
        UnicodeSegmentation::graphemes(&text[start..self.cursor], true).count()
    }

    fn open_save_as(&mut self) {
        if self.readonly {
            self.notification = Some("buffer is read-only".into());
            return;
        }
        self.save_as_open = true;
        self.save_as_input.clear();
    }

    fn apply_save_as(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        let input = self.save_as_input.trim();
        if input.is_empty() {
            self.notification = Some("save path is empty".into());
            return Ok(());
        }
        let target = PathBuf::from(input);
        let target = if target.is_absolute() {
            target
        } else {
            env::current_dir()?.join(target)
        };
        let previous_path = self.path.clone();
        let previous_baseline = self.baseline.clone();
        self.path = Some(target.clone());
        self.baseline = None;
        if let Err(error) = self.save() {
            self.path = previous_path;
            self.baseline = previous_baseline;
            return Err(error);
        }
        self.watcher = target
            .parent()
            .and_then(|parent| WorkspaceWatcher::new(parent).ok());
        self.git_repository = repository_for_path(&target);
        self.save_as_open = false;
        self.save_as_input.clear();
        self.notification = Some(format!("saved as {}", target.display()));
        Ok(())
    }

    fn conflict_marker_count(text: &str) -> usize {
        text.lines()
            .filter(|line| {
                let line = line.trim_start();
                line.starts_with("<<<<<<<")
                    || line.starts_with("=======")
                    || line.starts_with(">>>>>>>")
            })
            .count()
    }

    /// Drives the language server: starts it lazily, mirrors the current
    /// document and folds server events into UI state. Called once per frame by
    /// the event loop; it never waits longer than a single non-blocking poll.
    fn poll_lsp(&mut self) {
        if self.no_lsp {
            self.lsp_status = "LSP:off".into();
            return;
        }
        self.start_lsp_if_needed();
        self.sync_completion_after_edit();
        let Some(session) = self.lsp.as_mut() else {
            return;
        };

        // Mirror the active document. A server that is still initializing (or
        // restarting) must not receive didOpen: it has no document store yet.
        let path = self.path.clone();
        let version = self.document.version();
        let usable = session.client.state().is_usable();
        match (path.as_deref(), session.synced.clone()) {
            _ if !usable => {}
            (None, Some((previous, _))) => {
                let _ = session.client.did_close(&previous);
                session.synced = None;
            }
            (Some(current), Some((previous, _))) if previous != current => {
                let _ = session.client.did_close(&previous);
                let text = self.document.text();
                let _ = session.client.did_open(current, session.language, &text);
                session.synced = Some((current.to_path_buf(), version));
            }
            (Some(current), None) => {
                let text = self.document.text();
                let _ = session.client.did_open(current, session.language, &text);
                session.synced = Some((current.to_path_buf(), version));
            }
            (Some(current), Some((_, synced_version))) if synced_version != version => {
                let text = self.document.text();
                let _ = session.client.did_change(current, &text);
                session.synced = Some((current.to_path_buf(), version));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
        let events = session.client.pump(Duration::from_millis(0));
        // A restarted server has no document store: force a fresh didOpen.
        if events
            .iter()
            .any(|event| matches!(event, ClientEvent::StateChanged(Lifecycle::Restarting)))
        {
            session.synced = None;
        }
        let state = session.client.state();
        let server = session.server;
        let counts = session.client.diagnostics().counts();
        self.lsp_status = match state {
            Lifecycle::Ready if counts.total() == 0 => format!("LSP:{server}"),
            Lifecycle::Ready => format!("LSP:{server} {}E {}W", counts.errors, counts.warnings),
            Lifecycle::Degraded => format!("LSP:{server}!degraded"),
            Lifecycle::Spawning | Lifecycle::Initializing => format!("LSP:{server}…"),
            Lifecycle::Restarting => format!("LSP:{server}!restarting"),
            Lifecycle::Crashed => format!("LSP:{server}!crashed"),
            Lifecycle::Disabled => format!("LSP:{server}!disabled"),
            Lifecycle::Discovered => "LSP:idle".into(),
        };
        for event in events {
            match event {
                ClientEvent::Diagnostic {
                    path,
                    version,
                    diagnostics,
                } => {
                    self.lsp_diagnostics
                        .publish(&path, version, server, diagnostics);
                }
                ClientEvent::ProtocolError(message) => {
                    self.notification = Some(format!("LSP protocol error: {message}"));
                }
                ClientEvent::StateChanged(Lifecycle::Disabled) => {
                    self.notification = Some(format!(
                        "LSP server {server} disabled after repeated failures"
                    ));
                }
                ClientEvent::Response { id, result } if Some(id) == self.completion_request => {
                    self.completion_request = None;
                    let (items, incomplete) = parse_completion_result(&result);
                    self.completion_incomplete = incomplete;
                    if items.is_empty() {
                        self.completion_open = false;
                        self.completion_items.clear();
                    } else {
                        self.completion_items = items;
                        self.completion_open = true;
                        self.completion_selected = 0;
                        self.completion_scroll = 0;
                    }
                }
                ClientEvent::Response { id, result } if Some(id) == self.hover_request => {
                    self.hover_request = None;
                    self.hover_lines = parse_hover_result(&result)
                        .map(|text| text.lines().map(str::to_owned).collect::<Vec<_>>())
                        .unwrap_or_default();
                    self.hover_open = !self.hover_lines.is_empty();
                    self.hover_scroll = 0;
                }
                ClientEvent::Timeout { id, method } => {
                    if Some(id) == self.completion_request {
                        self.completion_request = None;
                    }
                    if Some(id) == self.hover_request {
                        self.hover_request = None;
                    }
                    self.notification = Some(format!("LSP request timed out: {method}"));
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    }

    /// Starts a server the first time a supported file is opened. The
    /// availability probe runs on a worker thread so the first frame is never
    /// blocked by a version probe (PRD NF-01 / A-11).
    fn start_lsp_if_needed(&mut self) {
        if self.lsp.is_some() {
            return;
        }
        if let Some(job) = &self.lsp_probe_job {
            match job.try_recv() {
                Ok((language, true)) => {
                    self.lsp_probe_job = None;
                    self.spawn_lsp_server(language);
                }
                Ok((language, false)) => {
                    self.lsp_probe_job = None;
                    let hint = recipe_for(language)
                        .map(|recipe| recipe.install_hint)
                        .unwrap_or("install the language server");
                    self.lsp_status = format!("LSP:{language}!missing");
                    self.notification = Some(format!(
                        "Language server not installed - run \"{hint}\" to enable it"
                    ));
                }
                Err(TryRecvError::Empty) => {}
                Err(TryRecvError::Disconnected) => self.lsp_probe_job = None,
            }
            return;
        }
        let Some(path) = self.path.clone() else {
            self.lsp_status = "LSP:no-file".into();
            return;
        };
        let Some(language) = lsp_language(&path) else {
            self.lsp_status = "LSP:no-recipe".into();
            return;
        };
        let Some(recipe) = recipe_for(language) else {
            self.lsp_status = "LSP:no-recipe".into();
            return;
        };
        self.lsp_status = format!("LSP:{}…", recipe.server);
        let (sender, receiver) = mpsc::channel();
        std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let installed = matches!(mtide_lsp::probe(recipe), ProbeResult::Installed { .. });
            let _ = sender.send((language, installed));
        });
        self.lsp_probe_job = Some(receiver);
    }

    fn spawn_lsp_server(&mut self, language: &'static str) {
        let Some(recipe) = recipe_for(language) else {
            return;
        };
        let root = self
            .workspace_roots
            .first()
            .cloned()
            .or_else(|| {
                self.path
                    .as_deref()
                    .and_then(Path::parent)
                    .map(Path::to_path_buf)
            })
            .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
        let spec = ServerSpec {
            program: recipe.server.to_owned(),
            args: recipe.args.iter().map(|arg| (*arg).to_owned()).collect(),
            root: root.clone(),
        };
        let config = ClientConfig {
            server_id: recipe.server.to_owned(),
            ..ClientConfig::default()
        };
        match LspClient::spawn(config, spec) {
            Ok(mut client) => {
                if let Err(error) = client.initialize(&root) {
                    self.notification = Some(format!("LSP initialize failed: {error}"));
                }
                self.lsp = Some(LspSession {
                    client,
                    server: recipe.server,
                    language,
                    synced: None,
                });
            }
            Err(error) => {
                self.lsp_status = format!("LSP:{}!failed", recipe.server);
                self.notification = Some(format!("LSP server failed to start: {error}"));
            }
        }
    }

    // --- completion and hover (LN-07 / LN-08) -------------------------------

    fn word_start_at(&self, at: usize) -> usize {
        let text = self.document.text();
        text[..at.min(text.len())]
            .char_indices()
            .rev()
            .take_while(|(_, character)| character.is_alphanumeric() || *character == '_')
            .last()
            .map(|(offset, _)| offset)
            .unwrap_or(at)
    }

    /// Requests completions at the cursor. The request is async; the popup only
    /// opens when the response arrives, so the UI never blocks on the server.
    fn request_completion(&mut self) {
        self.hover_open = false;
        let Some(path) = self.path.clone() else {
            return;
        };
        let text = self.document.text();
        let position = position_at(&text, self.cursor);
        let anchor = self.word_start_at(self.cursor);
        let Some(session) = self.lsp.as_mut() else {
            self.notification = Some("completion needs a running language server".into());
            return;
        };
        if !session.client.state().is_usable() {
            self.notification = Some(format!("LSP is {}", state_label(session.client.state())));
            return;
        }
        let params = serde_json::json!({
            "textDocument": { "uri": file_uri(&path) },
            "position": position,
            "context": { "triggerKind": 1 },
        });
        match session.client.request("textDocument/completion", params) {
            Ok(id) => {
                self.completion_request = Some(id);
                self.completion_anchor = anchor;
                self.completion_prefix = text[anchor..self.cursor].to_owned();
            }
            Err(error) => self.notification = Some(format!("completion failed: {error}")),
        }
    }

    fn request_hover(&mut self) {
        self.completion_open = false;
        let Some(path) = self.path.clone() else {
            return;
        };
        let text = self.document.text();
        let position = position_at(&text, self.cursor);
        let Some(session) = self.lsp.as_mut() else {
            self.notification = Some("hover needs a running language server".into());
            return;
        };
        if !session.client.state().is_usable() {
            self.notification = Some(format!("LSP is {}", state_label(session.client.state())));
            return;
        }
        let params = serde_json::json!({
            "textDocument": { "uri": file_uri(&path) },
            "position": position,
        });
        match session.client.request("textDocument/hover", params) {
            Ok(id) => self.hover_request = Some(id),
            Err(error) => self.notification = Some(format!("hover failed: {error}")),
        }
    }

    fn close_completion(&mut self) {
        self.completion_open = false;
        self.completion_items.clear();
        self.completion_selected = 0;
        self.completion_scroll = 0;
        self.completion_prefix.clear();
    }

    /// Candidate list after client-side prefix filtering. Servers return long
    /// lists; filtering here keeps typing responsive without a round trip.
    fn filtered_completions(&self) -> Vec<CompletionItem> {
        let prefix = self.completion_prefix.to_lowercase();
        let mut items = self
            .completion_items
            .iter()
            .filter(|item| item.label.to_lowercase().starts_with(&prefix))
            .cloned()
            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
        if items.is_empty() {
            items = self
                .completion_items
                .iter()
                .filter(|item| item.label.to_lowercase().contains(&prefix))
                .cloned()
                .collect();
        }
        items
    }

    /// Keeps the popup aligned with the buffer after an edit. A cursor that
    /// left the current word closes the popup instead of inserting elsewhere.
    fn sync_completion_after_edit(&mut self) {
        if !self.completion_open {
            return;
        }
        let text = self.document.text();
        if self.cursor < self.completion_anchor || self.cursor > text.len() {
            self.close_completion();
            return;
        }
        let prefix = text[self.completion_anchor..self.cursor].to_owned();
        if prefix
            .chars()
            .any(|character| !(character.is_alphanumeric() || character == '_'))
        {
            self.close_completion();
            return;
        }
        if prefix != self.completion_prefix {
            self.completion_prefix = prefix;
            self.completion_selected = 0;
            self.completion_scroll = 0;
            if self.filtered_completions().is_empty() && self.completion_incomplete {
                self.request_completion();
            }
        }
    }

    fn move_completion_selection(&mut self, delta: isize) {
        let len = self.filtered_completions().len();
        if len == 0 {
            return;
        }
        let next = (self.completion_selected as isize + delta).clamp(0, len as isize - 1);
        self.completion_selected = next as usize;
        let visible = 8usize;
        if self.completion_selected < self.completion_scroll {
            self.completion_scroll = self.completion_selected;
        } else if self.completion_selected >= self.completion_scroll + visible {
            self.completion_scroll = self.completion_selected + 1 - visible;
        }
    }

    /// Applies the selected item as a single undoable transaction: the primary
    /// edit, the server's additional edits (auto-imports) and the snippet
    /// tab stops all belong to the same user action.
    fn accept_completion(&mut self) -> Result<(), AppError> {
        let Some(item) = self
            .filtered_completions()
            .get(self.completion_selected)
            .cloned()
        else {
            self.close_completion();
            return Ok(());
        };
        self.close_completion();
        if self.readonly {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let text = self.document.text();
        let (start, end, raw) = match &item.text_edit {
            Some(edit) => (
                offset_at(&text, edit.start),
                offset_at(&text, edit.end),
                if edit.new_text.is_empty() {
                    item.insert_text.clone()
                } else {
                    edit.new_text.clone()
                },
            ),
            None => (
                self.completion_anchor,
                self.cursor,
                item.insert_text.clone(),
            ),
        };
        let filename = self
            .path
            .as_deref()
            .and_then(Path::file_name)
            .and_then(|name| name.to_str());
        let (insert, tabstops) = if item.snippet {
            let expansion = expand_snippet(&raw, filename);
            (expansion.text, expansion.tabstops)
        } else {
            (raw, Vec::new())
        };
        // Additional edits come first so that an insertion at the same offset as
        // the completion range keeps the server's intended order.
        let mut edits = Vec::with_capacity(item.additional_edits.len() + 1);
        let mut shift: isize = 0;
        for extra in &item.additional_edits {
            let extra_start = offset_at(&text, extra.start);
            let extra_end = offset_at(&text, extra.end);
            if extra_start <= start {
                shift += extra.new_text.len() as isize - (extra_end - extra_start) as isize;
            }
            edits.push(Edit {
                range: extra_start..extra_end,
                insert: extra.new_text.clone(),
            });
        }
        edits.push(Edit {
            range: start..end,
            insert: insert.clone(),
        });
        self.document.apply(&edits)?;
        let base = (start as isize + shift).max(0) as usize;
        self.cursor = base + insert.len();
        self.selection = None;
        if !tabstops.is_empty() {
            self.snippet_stops = tabstops
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(begin, end)| (base + begin, base + end))
                .collect();
            self.snippet_index = 0;
            if let Some((begin, end)) = self.snippet_stops.first().copied() {
                self.cursor = end;
                self.selection = (begin != end).then(|| Selection::new(begin, end));
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }

    fn draw_completion(&self, frame: &mut CellBuffer, width: u16, height: u16) {
        if !self.completion_open {
            return;
        }
        let items = self.filtered_completions();
        if items.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let box_width = width.saturating_sub(6).clamp(30, 72);
        let visible = items.len().min(8);
        let box_height = (visible as u16 + 2).min(height.saturating_sub(2));
        let left = width.saturating_sub(box_width) / 2;
        let top = height.saturating_sub(box_height + 2);
        for row in 0..box_height {
            frame.write_str(
                left,
                top + row,
                &" ".repeat(box_width as usize),
                ColorSlot::Muted,
            );
        }
        frame.write_str(
            left + 1,
            top,
            &format!(
                " Completions ({} of {}; Enter accept, Esc dismiss) ",
                items.len(),
                self.completion_items.len()
            ),
            ColorSlot::Focus,
        );
        for (offset, item) in items
            .iter()
            .skip(self.completion_scroll)
            .take(visible)
            .enumerate()
        {
            let index = self.completion_scroll + offset;
            let selected = index == self.completion_selected;
            let detail = if item.detail.is_empty() {
                String::new()
            } else {
                format!("  {}", item.detail)
            };
            let label = format!(
                "{} {}{}",
                if selected { ">" } else { " " },
                item.label,
                detail
            );
            frame.write_str(
                left + 1,
                top + 1 + offset as u16,
                &label,
                if selected {
                    ColorSlot::Focus
                } else {
                    ColorSlot::Default
                },
            );
        }
    }

    fn draw_hover(&self, frame: &mut CellBuffer, width: u16, height: u16) {
        if !self.hover_open || self.hover_lines.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        let box_width = width.saturating_sub(6).clamp(40, 100);
        let visible = self
            .hover_lines
            .len()
            .saturating_sub(self.hover_scroll)
            .min(10);
        let box_height = (visible as u16 + 2).min(height.saturating_sub(2));
        let left = width.saturating_sub(box_width) / 2;
        let top = height.saturating_sub(box_height + 2);
        for row in 0..box_height {
            frame.write_str(
                left,
                top + row,
                &" ".repeat(box_width as usize),
                ColorSlot::Muted,
            );
        }
        frame.write_str(
            left + 1,
            top,
            " Hover (Esc dismiss, ↑/↓ scroll) ",
            ColorSlot::Focus,
        );
        for (offset, line) in self
            .hover_lines
            .iter()
            .skip(self.hover_scroll)
            .take(visible)
            .enumerate()
        {
            frame.write_str(left + 1, top + 1 + offset as u16, line, ColorSlot::Default);
        }
    }

    /// Height of one logical line measured in visual rows.
    fn visual_line_height(&self, line: &str) -> usize {
        if self.word_wrap && !self.large_file_mode && self.wrap_width > 0 {
            wrap_line(line, self.wrap_width).len().max(1)
        } else {
            1
        }
    }

    /// Keeps the cursor line inside the viewport. The scan is bounded by the
    /// viewport height, so the cost does not grow with the distance from the
    /// top of the file (PRD ED-12 / NF-02).
    fn ensure_cursor_visible(&mut self, lines: &[&str], content_height: usize) {
        if content_height == 0 || lines.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
        if self.editor_scroll >= lines.len() {
            self.editor_scroll = lines.len() - 1;
        }
        // Only re-anchor when the cursor actually moved: otherwise a manual
        // scroll (wheel / page keys) would be pulled back on the next frame.
        if self.cursor == self.editor_scroll_cursor {
            return;
        }
        self.editor_scroll_cursor = self.cursor;
        let cursor_line = self.current_line().min(lines.len() - 1);
        if cursor_line < self.editor_scroll {
            self.editor_scroll = cursor_line;
            return;
        }
        let mut rows = 0usize;
        for line in lines.iter().take(cursor_line + 1).skip(self.editor_scroll) {
            rows += self.visual_line_height(line);
            if rows > content_height {
                break;
            }
        }
        if rows <= content_height {
            return;
        }
        // Scroll the minimum amount that puts the cursor line on the last row.
        let mut budget = content_height.saturating_sub(1);
        let mut start = cursor_line;
        while start > 0 {
            let height = self.visual_line_height(lines[start - 1]);
            if height > budget {
                break;
            }
            budget -= height;
