    #[test]
    fn fr_ln06_poll_lsp_mirrors_the_document_and_folds_diagnostics() {
        use std::io::BufReader;
        use std::os::unix::net::UnixStream;

        let (client_stream, server_stream) = UnixStream::pair().expect("socket pair");
        let reader = client_stream.try_clone().expect("clone client reader");
        let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            let _ = server_stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_millis(150)));
            let mut server_reader =
                BufReader::new(server_stream.try_clone().expect("clone server reader"));
            let mut server_writer = server_stream;
            loop {
                let Ok(Some(message)) = mtide_proc::read_message(&mut server_reader) else {
                    return;
                };
                match message.get("method").and_then(|value| value.as_str()) {
                    Some("initialize") => {
                        mtide_proc::write_message(
                            &mut server_writer,
                            &serde_json::json!({
                                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                                "id": message["id"],
                                "result": { "capabilities": { "textDocumentSync": 1 } },
                            }),
                        )
                        .expect("answer initialize");
                    }
                    Some("textDocument/didOpen") => {
                        let uri = message["params"]["textDocument"]["uri"].clone();
                        mtide_proc::write_message(
                            &mut server_writer,
                            &serde_json::json!({
                                "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                                "method": "textDocument/publishDiagnostics",
                                "params": {
                                    "uri": uri,
                                    "version": 0,
                                    "diagnostics": [{
                                        "range": {
                                            "start": { "line": 0, "character": 0 },
                                            "end": { "line": 0, "character": 3 },
                                        },
                                        "severity": 1,
                                        "source": "test-lsp",
                                        "message": "boom",
                                    }],
                                },
                            }),
                        )
                        .expect("publish diagnostics");
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
        });

        let mut app = App::open(
            None,
            false,
            Some("fn main() {}".into()),
            PathBuf::from("/tmp/mtide-lsp-wiring-session.json"),
            None,
            None,
        )
        .expect("open document");
        app.path = Some(PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace/src/main.rs"));
        let mut client = LspClient::attach(
            ClientConfig {
                server_id: "test-lsp".into(),
                ..ClientConfig::default()
            },
            reader,
            client_stream,
        );
        client
            .initialize(Path::new("/tmp/workspace"))
            .expect("start handshake");
        app.lsp = Some(LspSession {
            client,
            server: "test-lsp",
            language: "rust",
            synced: None,
        });

        let deadline = Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(3);
        while Instant::now() < deadline {
            app.poll_lsp();
            if app
                .lsp_diagnostics
                .file(Path::new("/tmp/workspace/src/main.rs"))
                .is_some()
            {
                break;
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(5));
        }
        let stored = app
            .lsp_diagnostics
            .file(Path::new("/tmp/workspace/src/main.rs"))
            .expect("diagnostics folded into the app store");
        assert_eq!(stored.diagnostics[0].message, "boom");
        assert!(
            app.lsp_status.contains("1E"),
            "status must surface the error count: {}",
            app.lsp_status
        );
        assert_eq!(
            app.lsp
                .as_ref()
                .and_then(|session| session.synced.clone())
                .map(|(path, _)| path),
            Some(PathBuf::from("/tmp/workspace/src/main.rs")),
            "the server must have been told which document is open"
        );

        // Closing the buffer must tell the server and reset the sync marker.
        app.path = None;
        app.poll_lsp();
        assert_eq!(
            app.lsp.as_ref().and_then(|session| session.synced.clone()),
            None
        );
        handle.join().expect("server thread");
    }

    #[test]
    fn fr_ed11_external_save_conflict_stays_open_and_is_visible() {
        let path = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("mtide-conflict-{}.txt", std::process::id()));
        fs::write(&path, "original").expect("write original");
        let mut app = App::open(
            Some(path.clone()),
            false,
            None,
            std::env::temp_dir().join("mtide-conflict-session.json"),
            None,
            None,
        )
        .expect("open conflict document");
        fs::write(&path, "changed outside").expect("external edit");
        app.document
            .apply(&[Edit {
                range: 0..0,
                insert: "x".into(),
            }])
            .expect("local edit");
        assert!(!app
            .handle(KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('s'), KeyModifiers::CONTROL))
            .expect("save key"));
        assert!(app.external_change);
        assert!(app
            .status_line(200, app.document.text().len())
            .contains("save blocked"));
        app.handle(KeyEvent::new(
            KeyCode::Char('d'),
            KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::ALT,
        ))
        .expect("compare external file");
        assert!(app
            .notification
            .as_deref()
            .is_some_and(|message| message.starts_with("compare:")));
        app.handle(KeyEvent::new(KeyCode::Char('r'), KeyModifiers::CONTROL))
            .expect("reload external file");
        assert_eq!(app.document.text(), "changed outside");
        app.document
            .apply(&[Edit {
                range: 0..0,
                insert: "local ".into(),
            }])
            .expect("local edit after reload");
        fs::write(&path, "changed again").expect("second external edit");
        app.external_change = true;
        app.handle(KeyEvent::new(
            KeyCode::Char('s'),
            KeyModifiers::CONTROL | KeyModifiers::SHIFT,
        ))
        .expect("overwrite external file");
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read_to_string(&path).expect("read overwritten file"),
            "local changed outside"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_file(path);
    }

        let mut restored =
            App::open(None, false, None, session, None, None).expect("restore session");
        assert_eq!(restored.path, Some(file.clone()));
        assert!(restored.document.text().contains("edited"));
        assert!(restored.cursor > 0);
        fs::write(&file, "fn main() { externally changed }\n").expect("external edit");
        restored.last_watch_poll =
            std::time::Instant::now() - std::time::Duration::from_millis(101);
        restored.poll_workspace_changes();
        assert_eq!(
            restored.document.text(),
            "fn main() { externally changed }\n"
        );
        assert!(!restored.external_change);
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fr_ws03_restore_preserves_unsaved_snapshot_as_dirty() {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("mtide-dirty-{}", std::process::id()));
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).expect("create dirty fixture");
        let file = root.join("main.rs");
        let session = root.join("session.json");
        fs::write(&file, "before\n").expect("write source");
        let mut app = App::open(Some(file.clone()), false, None, session.clone(), None, None)
            .expect("open source");
        app.document
            .apply(&[Edit {
                range: 0..0,
                insert: "unsaved\n".into(),
            }])
            .expect("edit source");
        app.persist_session().expect("persist dirty session");
        let restored = App::open(None, false, None, session, None, None).expect("restore session");
        assert!(restored.document.is_dirty());
        assert!(restored.document.text().starts_with("unsaved\n"));
        // The snapshot is older than the file, so it must be flagged as a
        // conflict instead of being autosaved over it.
        assert!(restored.external_change);
        assert!(restored
            .notification
            .as_deref()
            .is_some_and(|message| message.contains("restored unsaved session changes")));
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }

    #[test]
    fn fr_ed13_editor_save_preserves_crlf_line_endings() {
        let root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("mtide-crlf-{}", std::process::id()));
        fs::create_dir_all(&root).expect("create test directory");
        let path = root.join("main.rs");
        fs::write(&path, b"a\r\nb\r\n").expect("write CRLF file");
        let mut app = App::open(
            Some(path.clone()),
            false,
            None,
            root.join("session.json"),
            None,
            None,
        )
        .expect("open CRLF file");
        let end = app.document.text().len();
        app.document
            .apply(&[Edit {
                range: end..end,
                insert: "c\n".into(),
            }])
            .expect("edit CRLF file");
        app.save().expect("save CRLF file");
        assert_eq!(
            fs::read(&path).expect("read saved file"),
            b"a\r\nb\r\nc\r\n"
        );
        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(root);
    }
